method: felt-subset bias of catalog-truth GMPE predictions vs windowed kmoni period-max; additive intensity correction, clamped [-1.5,0.5], min 2 events per bin

zhao2006.note: Additive distance-binned intensity correction for zhao2006-routed forecasts, re-fitted 2026-08-17 against the FAITHFUL Zhao et al. (2006) implementation (paper Tables 4/5/6, natural-log form, native Vs30 site classes) from frozen K-NET/KiK-net station residuals (tohoku2011, tokachi2003, fukushima2022, hyuganada2024; 1925 stations) with JMA-catalog prediction hypocenters by tools/scorecard-strong-motion.js --fit-model-bias=zhao2006. The faithful model is unbiased inside 100 km (measured -0.01..-0.03 intensity); the >100 km bins correct the point-source hypocentral-distance convention against mega-ruptures (true Rrup scoring in tools/probe-zhao2006-faithful.js: overall PGA bias +0.11). deltaI = -(measured per-bin bias), hard-capped at +/-1.0; applies only at M>=7 (fitted range M7.1-9.1) and inside the measured hypocentral-distance bins; bins outside the measured range are no-ops. Si-midorikawa-routed crustal events and explicitly user-selected kanno2006 forecasts carry their own modelBias blocks below. See tools/data/strong-motion-report.json.

si-midorikawa.note: Additive distance-binned intensity correction for si-midorikawa-routed forecasts, fitted 2026-08-14 from frozen K-NET/KiK-net station residuals (kumamoto2016, noto2024; 701 stations) with JMA-catalog prediction hypocenters by tools/scorecard-strong-motion.js --fit-model-bias=si-midorikawa. deltaI = -(measured per-bin bias), hard-capped at +/-1.0; applies only at M>=7 (fitted range M7.0-7.5) and inside the measured hypocentral-distance bins; bins outside the measured range are no-ops. Fitted on hypocentral distance, while the app forecast path evaluates si-mid finite faults on Rrup — the bins are a near-field approximation (all |deltaI| <= 0.23 within 400 km). See tools/data/strong-motion-report.json.

kanno2006.note: Additive distance-binned intensity correction for explicitly user-selected kanno2006 forecasts (auto routing never selects kanno2006), fitted 2026-08-14 by forcing the model onto all six frozen events (tohoku2011, kumamoto2016, tokachi2003, fukushima2022, noto2024, hyuganada2024; 2626 stations) with JMA-catalog prediction hypocenters by tools/scorecard-strong-motion.js --fit-model-bias=kanno2006 (forced-model fit). deltaI = -(measured per-bin bias), hard-capped at +/-1.0; applies only at M>=7 (fitted range M7.0-9.1) and inside the measured hypocentral-distance bins; bins outside the measured range are no-ops. Bins with fewer than 15 stations are dropped (none were). See tools/data/strong-motion-report.json.
